result.description:
Farnese Australia Pty Ltd. is seeking a full Time Service Technician to join our team based in Ingleburn NSW.

Reporting to the Services Manager, this is a hands-on, permanent role where you will play a key part in machine installations, preventive and breakdown maintenance. You will work across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems, servicing machinery such as CNC Machine Centres, Bridge Saws, Block Saws, and Jib / Gantry Cranes.
This role offers variety and the opportunity to work both autonomously and within a team. While qualifications are not essential, any mechanical or electrical aptitude will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities:
•	Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of machinery.
•	Install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Install and service equipment, including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components.
•	Interpret electrical drawings and perform diagnostic checks.
•	Liaise with clients to understand and address service requirements.

What We Offer:
•	A permanent, full-time role in a supportive team environment.
•	A company vehicle for both work and personal use.
•	Opportunity for hands-on, technical work with diverse, cutting edge equipment.

Essential Criteria
•	Ability to interpret electrical and mechanical concepts and drawings.
•	Ability to install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Previous experience in machinery preventive maintenance.
•	Strong mechanical aptitude and fault-finding skills.
•	Excellent communication and client liaison skills.
•	Reliable work ethic with attention to detail and accuracy.
•	Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
•	Current driver's licence.
•	Minimum of less than 1 year of machinery preventive maintenance experience required.
•	Ability to interpret basic electrical symbols and drawings required.

Desirable Criteria:
•	Electrical fault-finding experience.
•	Knowledge of electrical control systems.
•	Experience with CNC machine technology and operation.
•	Background in the stone industry, manufacturing, or machinery service.

Renumeration: $85,000 - $105,000 + Super for the right candidate.

If you are looking for a hands-on, technically challenging role with the potential to grow and expand your skill set, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and become an integral part of our team at Farnese Australia.

result.description: Ibavale Pty Ltd t/as Electronic Diesel Technology  Ibavale Pty Ltd, trading as Electronic Diesel Technology, is a family-owned Australian business that has proudly served the diesel industry for decades. We specialise in the repair, servicing and calibration of electronic injectors and common rail fuel injection systems for a range of diesel engine applications. We also supply truck engine parts, diagnostic tools, software, electrical connectors and related accessories for diesel engine platforms including Cat, Cummins, Detroit and Mack.  Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an experienced Senior Diesel Motor Mechanic / Diesel Fuel Injection Specialist to join our team.   Position Title:  Senior Diesel Motor Mechanic / Diesel Fuel Injection Specialist   Employment Type:  full time   Location:  WARRENHEIP VIC 3352   Benefits   Competitive remuneration package based on experience and technical capability.  Stable, long-term career opportunity with a well-established family-owned business.  Work on advanced diesel fuel injection systems and cutting-edge diagnostic technologies.  Opportunities for professional development and technical leadership.  Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality and innovation.    Task & responsibilities   Serve as a senior technical lead for Diesel Injection Fuel Systems specifically for Heavy Duty and Large Engine applications, providing expert knowledge on diagnostics, repair and servicing of injectors, fuel pumps and related components.  Provide deep-dive troubleshooting, diagnostics, repair, testing, calibration, and oversight for Common Rail and Modular Common Rail Systems (MCRS) in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry standards.   Review and refine existing diagnostic and repair procedures. Identify technical bottlenecks, and optimise workshop efficiency by applying technical expertise. Contribute to operational strategies and continuous improvement initiatives that support service capability expansion and business growth.   Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, testing procedures and standardized operating procedures (SOPs) that facilitate company scaling and consistent service delivery.  Manage and mentor technical staff, fostering a culture of accountability. Maintain quality output and ensure all deliverables meet rigorous industry standards.  Monitor developments in diesel fuel injection systems and lead initiatives to implement improved diagnostic methods, testing procedures and repair techniques, as well as new product offerings and component solutions for newer generations of engines and advanced fuel systems.    Qualification & experience  We are seeking a results-driven professional with more than 10 years of experience and deep technical roots in Diesel Injection Fuel Systems to lead our technical operations. Certificate III in Automotive Diesel Engine Technology or equivalent is preferred. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between complex technical and scalable workshop operations. You will be responsible for leading and overseeing the lifecycle of Common Rail and MCRS technologies while simplifying workflows to drive efficiency and team performance.   Essential skills for this role:    Mastery of Diesel Injection Systems for Heavy Duty/Large Engines.  Expert-level understanding of Common Rail and MCRS architecture.  Proven ability to perform complex diagnostics, testing, repair and calibration of diesel fuel injection components in accordance with manufacturer specifications.  Demonstrated skills to research, test, and implement advanced systems and repair techniques and products for newer engine technologies.  Proven ability to design, document, and implement highly efficient workflows.   If you have the skills, experience and passion to excel in this specialist role, we would love to hear from you.
